say:2:1322004001:0.text: Hey, little one, what's wrong? Why are you crying?
say:2:1322004001:0.source_cn: 小朋友，你怎么了，哭得这么伤心？

say:3:1322004002:0.text: Is it because of the terrifying ghosts kidnapping children at night? You must be really scared, huh?
say:3:1322004002:0.source_cn: 是不是因为最近晚上有恐怖的幽魂会带孩子出门，你觉得很可怕？！

say:5:1322004003:0.text: *Cry*... What ghosts? I'm not scared to go out at night...
say:5:1322004003:0.source_cn: 呜呜……没有幽魂！我才不害怕晚上出门玩……

say:6:1322004004:0.text: *Cry*... It's because I can't find Gary and Rivanna...
say:6:1322004004:0.source_cn: 呜，我是因为找不到杰洛米和里芙娜了……

say:8:1322004005:1.text: We were playing hide-and-seek, but they hid too well. I-I can't find them. It's been a long while...
say:8:1322004005:1.source_cn: 我们在玩捉迷藏，可是他们藏得太好了，我、我怎么都找不到...

choice_prompt:9:1322004005.text: We were playing hide-and-seek, but they hid too well. I-I can't find them. It's been a long while...
choice_prompt:9:1322004005.source_cn: 我们在玩捉迷藏，可是他们藏得太好了，我、我怎么都找不到，都过了好长时间了……呜呜……

say:10:1322004006:0.text: Really? Then you have to help me find Gary and Rivanna, Mister!
say:10:1322004006:0.male: Really? Then you have to help me find Gary and Rivanna, Mister!
say:10:1322004006:0.female: Really? Then you have to help me find Gary and Rivanna, Miss!

say:11:1322004007:0.text: Of course, we'll help you! After we find them, can you help us answer some questions?
say:11:1322004007:0.source_cn: 当然啦！如果我们找到了你的朋友，你回答我们几个问题好不好？

say:12:1322004009:0.text: If you help me find them, Mister, I'll answer any questions you ask!
say:12:1322004009:0.male: If you help me find them, Mister, I'll answer any questions you ask!
say:12:1322004009:0.female: If you help me find them, Miss, I'll answer any questions you ask!

say:13:1322004010:1.text: That's great! Chippy's a pro at hide-and-seek!
say:13:1322004010:1.source_cn: 那就看满满的，满满最擅长捉迷藏了！

choice:9:1:2.text: We can help, but we have questions.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 可以，但你要回答我的问题
choice:9:1:2.male: We can help, but we have questions.
choice:9:1:2.female: We can help, but we have questions.

say:15:1322004008:0.text: *Cry*... Please, Mister. Help me find them...
say:15:1322004008:0.male: *Cry*... Please, Mister. Help me find them...
say:15:1322004008:0.female: *Cry*... Please, Miss. Help me find them...

choice_prompt:16:1322004008.source_cn: 呜呜……求你了，<male>大哥哥</male><female>大姐姐</female>，你帮帮我嘛……
choice_prompt:16:1322004008.male: *Cry*... Please, Mister. Help me find them...
choice_prompt:16:1322004008.female: *Cry*... Please, Miss. Help me find them...
